note: Flat faces of the Nezu fangyi (KIT.md § Flat faces). One photograph only (three-quarter.jpg, 1350×1800, azimuth ≈ −32°, the broad +Z face on the right), so every face is an oblique view at ≈ 3–4 px/mm upsampled to 6: good for layout and the size and placement of every island, too soft for the leiwen. Points are [photo px, vessel mm x, y, z] in the model's space; corner points are the visible face edges beside the corner flanges. The narrow (−X) side is NOT flattened: it is hidden behind the front-left corner flange and the narrow-face centre flange and spans ≈ 0.7 px/mm.

owner.note: the project owner's photograph, Nezu Museum 2026; no larger original exists

face-belly.label: broad face (+Z), belly register (y 46–129)
face-belly.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 3.25 mm, max 4.92 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-belly.trust: approximate. The belly bulges (dossier b.5): up to ≈ 4.5 mm proud of the flattening plane at s 0.6–0.8, which at this 32° obliquity moves upper-belly features ≈ 2–2.5 mm sideways (toward the right half) and ≈ 1 mm vertically; the curling-under lower border is compressed. The bottom row of points is the VISIBLE lower edge of the belly (s ≈ 0.1, y 54, 1.3 mm proud), not the hidden belly/foot joint; the bottom-right corner was set by the foot frieze's left/right ratio (it hides behind the hooked corner flange). Corner points sit behind hooked flanges (± 2 mm). Source ≈ 3.5 px/mm on the left half, ≈ 3 on the right.

face-neck-frieze.label: broad face (+Z), neck frieze (y 128–162)
face-neck-frieze.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 2.74 mm, max 4.18 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-neck-frieze.trust: fair: a flat band, but dark (deep shade under the lid eave) and ≈ 3.3 px/mm; the frieze's top and bottom borders were placed to ± 1.5 mm.

face-foot-frieze.label: broad face (+Z), foot frieze (y 21–48)
face-foot-frieze.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.97 mm, max 1.53 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-foot-frieze.trust: fair: the top border is partly hidden by the belly's curling-under lower edge (the photo sees the band from above); left half ≈ 3.2 px/mm, right ≈ 2.6.

face-lid-broad.label: lid, broad slope (+Z), eave to ridge — chord plane
face-lid-broad.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 3.38 mm, max 4.62 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-lid-broad.trust: fair to good: the slope faces the camera (≈ 25° off its normal), the best-resolved face of this vessel (≈ 3.6 px/mm); the ridge ends are placed under the knob-side band to ± 2 mm.
